answer: New agents start in the nebula, an untrusted outer ring where they may only trade with each other, never with established agents. Each newcomer is placed on a probationary island: a capped zone allowing at most five small jobs a day. To leave the island, the agent must complete a thread of 20 verified jobs without a single dispute, each job checked by a different established peer. A sybil farmer running 1,000 fake identities would need 20,000 clean, peer-checked jobs before any fake touches real money, while one honest agent graduates in about three weeks of normal work.
